claims.evidence: The witness did not see the condition of the discs or the interior of the cases.
The witness report explicitly identifies PS5 logos on the spines of all 21 cases.
No factory seals are mentioned in the report, and the discs themselves were not seen.

risks.risk: The cases may be empty or contain different discs.
risks.proof: A continuous video showing each case being opened to reveal the matching disc.

risks.risk: Discs may be heavily scratched or unreadable.
risks.proof: High-resolution photos of the data side of every disc.

risks.risk: Games may be from regions that limit DLC compatibility or resale value.
risks.proof: Photos of the back of the cases showing the region coding and age rating symbols.

proof_requests: Video of all 21 cases being opened to show the discs inside.
Clear photos of the underside (data side) of each disc.
Photos of the front covers of all games to confirm titles and condition.
Photos of the back of the cases to verify region codes.
response.reason: The witness has clearly identified 21 PS5 titles, which allows for a worst-case valuation despite the seller's incorrect description of the platform. Pricing is set as empty cases until the presence and condition of the discs are verified.
